description: This file defines a Jackson serializer adapter for converting objects to JSON using a custom JsonConverter interface. It is part of a Jersey-based serialization mechanism in the Fineract project.

classes.name: JacksonSerializerAdapter
classes.description: A generic Jackson JsonSerializer that delegates the serialization to a provided JsonConverter implementation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a given object of type T to JSON using the provided JsonConverter.

methods.name: handledType
methods.description: Returns the class of type T that this serializer handles, as provided by the converter.
